meta.title: Coming soon — Erveca Studio
meta.desc: Erveca Studio roadmap: events, fairs and the development of Almazuela Picross, Erveca and our new puzzle game.
meta.keywords: Erveca Studio, roadmap, coming soon, video game events La Rioja, Almazuela Picross, Erveca RPG
hero.label: Coming soon
hero.title: Where we stand
hero.lead: Here we tell you what we're working on and where you'll find us. Each path reads from bottom to top: what we've already covered sits at the bottom and what is still to come is at the top. When you open it, we drop you straight at the next stop.
roadmap.status: From bottom to top: {n} stops on the {label} roadmap.

eventos.label: Events
eventos.intro: Fairs, workshops and meetups where we'll be, with Cameros front and centre.

2026-09-12.description: We bring Almazuela Picross to Zaragoza for the first time at an event full of talks and indie game demos.

2026-09-21.description: We take Almazuela Picross to the Irun expotaku for two days with our own stand. See you there?

2026-10-03.title: Digitising cultural heritage for video games
2026-10-03.description: We'll explain how we digitised cultural elements for a video game, understanding its limitations, and we'll create designs working on the Almazuelas.

2026-10-19.title: Erveca Space at the 3rd Rioja Comic Festival
2026-10-19.description: Sewing, workshops on the impact of video games on us, and a showcase of Almazuela Picross, Erveca: Goddess of the skies, and projects from other studios such as Unclouded and Vareia.

2026-11-12.title: Heritage Autumn 2026
2026-11-12.description: We'll talk about how to carry heritage into the digital age through video games, and we'll play Almazuela Picross while looking at original almazuelas.

2026-11-19.description: A talk on how video games have entered our lives through mobile devices and a workshop on how to create a game with Unity in a small team.

2026-11-21.title: 3rd La Rioja Culture Meeting
2026-11-21.description: Who we are as a game studio, how we work and where we're heading.

2026-12-01.description: We present Almazuela Picross at this digital event with handcrafted demos, without generative AI, from more than 25 studios.

almazuela-picross.intro: Our nonogram (picross) puzzle on Steam and Google Play keeps growing with new patches. Will you join us in weaving an almazuela?

2026-05-26.title: Launch on Steam and Google Play
2026-05-26.description: The digital almazuela workshop arrives on PC and Android. Will you help us weave the 20 almazuelas the artisans of Cameros have shown us?

2026-08-22.title: 14th Hanging Almazuelas Festival
2026-08-22.description: An update with eight more almazuelas from the Cameros region and an almazuela design contest for everyone who wants to take part!

2026-11-01.title: Autumn update
2026-11-01.description: Four new almazuelas from Villoslada de Cameros and accessibility improvements so that no one is left unable to weave.

erveca.intro: The adventure RPG set in the Thirteen Villages of Camero Nuevo, where fantasy blends with the traditions and legends of its villages: our flagship project.

2025-12-27.title: Quests demo
2025-12-27.description: Creation of the event and quest system with a first playable commission in which you can roam the map looking for 5 almazuelas.

2026-02-07.title: Bug fixes and atmosphere improvements
2026-02-07.description: New graphic elements that improve the atmosphere and fixes for bugs in the quests demo.

2027-03-07.title: Public demo on itch.io
2027-03-07.description: Bringing the Almazuela Picross systems into Erveca, adding content to the existing demo.

goddess.intro: We start at the end: the narrative game that begins by telling what happened to the Erveca valley after the ending of the original title. You won't need to have followed Erveca's development to enjoy it.

2026-11-30.title: Steam page
2026-11-30.description: Creation of the Steam page and first steps to prepare the playtest. Throughout this month the game will be shown at all our events. See events.
